description:
### WARP Patches (v1.0.0)

* **Spoof WARP+ Unlimited UI**: Forces the account type of every AccountData instance to WARP+ UNLIMITED, so the app displays the WARP+ Unlimited interface
* **Morphe Manager Listing**: The patch is selectable in Morphe Manager for the supported app version

Supports 1.1.1.1 + WARP: Safer Internet v6.38.11 (APKM).
